svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Atlas Segments view (⌥5) as 3D columns, region × service tier (INC-2041)
svg.desc: The Segments view drawn as a 3D bar field. A floor carries the matrix: nine regions as rows ranked by care from front to back, five service tiers as columns, with row and column labels painted on the floor. Each segment is a column whose height is its error rate and whose colour is its worst health state; healthy segments are short grey stubs. eu-west-1 × Tier 0 (checkout, payments, cart) is the tall glowing Failing column, 4.1% errors, topped by the ⊕ origin marker for INC-2041 (payments → psp-api). Its neighbours in the same row are desaturated victims with dashed floor rings. LON-DC2 segments are hatched ghost columns because telemetry is stale; cells with no entities are empty floor marked with a dash. A translucent dashed plane marks the 1% SLO height across the field. Docked 2D: the selected row eu-west-1 as bars per tier with −7d ticks, and a segment Inspector with the care score breakdown, alerts grouped by incident and entities by care. A chip offers T: flat matrix. HUD: top bar, view switcher with Segments active, layer chips with Health active, Orbit · Map · Fly chip, altitude ladder, minimap, orbit gizmo and the Time Ribbon.
